verdict.rationale: Docs show structured, typed reports (Document, Facial Similarity, Watchlist/PEP/Adverse Media, Known Faces) retrievable via API/webhook, giving machine-readable outcomes and risk signals that could drive automated branching (e.g., watchlist hits, repeat-fraud flags). However, there is no explicit documentation of a result schema, granular failure-reason codes, or confidence/risk scores designed for agent decision logic. missing for 10: explicit JSON result schema with failure-reason enumerations, documented risk-score fields, and any agent/automation-oriented branching examples.
